text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! "Ticketzo Express" is officially 
open for business~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Look, remember how I carried everyone's 
stuff in that game? The whole town was so 
happy! So I thought I'd love to try doing 
that at the academy too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Running around to deliver everyone's 
precious packages and filling the place 
with smiles...!! How's that sound!?"
choice_data_list: It'll be good training too, so I'll help!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo-san, are you really sure it's 
okay for you to carry this luggage...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Yuki-chan, focus, focus on the mock 
race! The delivery destination is... a 
shop inside the shopping mall, right?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! I wanted to send a thank-you to 
the shop clerk who's always so kind when 
helping me pick out clothes—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but if you're busy, ya don't have to 
give it to 'em! I picked it out myself, so 
who knows if they'll even like it or 
not...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Why why why? Weren't you super happy 
about how heartfelt the clerk's service 
was, Yuki-chan? So that's why...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! A thank-you straight from 
your heart, Yuki-chan, is bound to—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No... Absolutely! They're gonna love it! 
'Cause I'll make sure to deliver 
Yuki-chan's feelings along with it!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-Hawaaa...!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? Then, please. Just hand it over 
whenever. Sounds like she's somewhere 
nearby anyway.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a package for your mom...?!! Ah, 
could it be a birthday present?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Weeeeell... I guess so?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see!! It's a present!! The wrapping is 
super pretty too!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's nothing... I was just scribbling 
on some scrap paper around here—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wah!! Jordan, you wrapped it yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's why it looks so wonderful...! 
Because all those feelings for your mother 
are poured into it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me!! Jordan's precious 
feelings— I'll deliver every single, 
solitary one of them to your mom!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gah! It's not like that at all!! Ugh, 
jeez, this is why Ticket-san is so...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"A cat-shaped cookie cutter, huh... From 
Hayahide... hmph."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin...!! That smile...!! That's the 
smile Hayahide wanted to see so badly!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, yeah. Same old routine, huh. You 
just bought it because you happened to see 
it, right?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's not true...!! Hayahide thought 
really, really hard about what would make 
you happy, Taishin, I know she did!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Way too dramatic. It's not like that at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank goodness~~!! Hayahide's feelings 
finally reached Taishin!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because Hayahide and I both love that 
super wonderful smile of yours, Taishin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: !! ...Are you an IDIOT!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Why are you mad!? Taishi~~~n!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—Did you hear that...?!" "—Y-Yeah! Does 
that mean...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rumors of Winning Ticket's incredible 
performance that day quickly spread 
throughout the academy—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
! I'm gonna deliver everyone's precious 
cargo all day long~~! ...Or so I was 
thinking—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—Wait, is that the rumored Ticketzo 
Express?!” “—They deliver heart-throbbing 
thrills too, right? So dreamy~!” “—I-If I 
hire them, my heart might not survive 
it...”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, lately it feels like a lot of 
people have been looking at me for some 
reason~
choice_data_list:
"Ticketzo Express" is truly a force to be 
reckoned with!
I might understand how you feel...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... everyone thinks I'm 
amazing...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I seeee! Ehehe, then I gotta work even 
harder, huh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right, Trainer! I came up with 
a greeting to help put our guests at ease!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"‘We'll safely deliver your heartfelt 
feelings too! Ticketzo Delivery: safe and 
reliable!’ ...How's that!?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hawawawawaaa~~...!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We did it~!! Looks like everyone's really 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? I don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, what kind of feeling is that? 
...If it feels bad, then I—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Aah! N-No, that's not it! —M-My heart's 
just racing, that's all...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: !! Thumping heart!? Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's just like the Derbyyyy!! My heart's 
always pounding like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket was completely and utterly 
oblivious...!
